about:
Telan Corporation operates from an 18,000-square-foot facility in Hatfield, Pennsylvania. The company was founded in 2003 and is led by President and CEO Conrad J. Nelson, with Shawn Goodwin as Director of Operations & Purchasing and George Kohn as Plant Manager & Quality Assurance.

Telan specializes in contract electronics manufacturing, providing printed circuit board assembly services that span surface-mount, through-hole, and mixed-technology processes. The facility supports both lead-free and leaded soldering using reflow ovens, wave soldering, and fully automated selective soldering equipment, along with hand soldering for delicate requirements. Additional capabilities include conformal coating, automated optical inspection (Mirtec MV-3), functional testing, box-build assembly, and PCB sourcing for consignment or turnkey programs. The shop handles high-volume, low-mix production as well as small-quantity runs.

The company serves original equipment manufacturers in sectors such as hospitality security and monitoring systems, as evidenced by long-term client testimonials. Customers range from those needing quick-turn prototypes to those requiring sustained high-volume delivery.

Telan emphasizes IPC-A-610 workmanship standards, competitive pricing, and on-time delivery as its core differentiators. The firm promotes fast quote turnaround (24–48 hours), typical production lead times of three to four weeks, and a commitment to long-term customer relationships built on consistent quality and responsive service.
